question.text: A travelling microscope is used to determine the refractive index of a glass slab. If 40 divisions are there in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> on main scale and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>50</mn></math> Vernier scale divisions are equal to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>49</mn></math> main scale divisions, then least count of the travelling microscope is _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Given here, main scale reading, MS=140 cm

And, 50×VS=49×MS

Least count of travelling microscope is LC=MS-VS

=MS-4950 MS

=150×MS

=150×140 cm=12000×10-2 m

=5×10-6 m
